en.hubeali: Humeyd, from Ibn Sama’at, from Safwan, from Hareyz, from Muhammad Bin Muslim who said,
‘I said to Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, ‘A man says to his wife, ‘
’. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘There is no expiation upon him, nor a divorce’.
en.sarwar: 4. Humayd ibn Ziyad has narrated from ibn Sama‘ah from Safwan from Hariz from Muhammad ibn Muslim who has said the following: “I once asked abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, about the case of a man who says to his wife, ‘
There is no expiation on him and it is not a divorce.’”
